UK Police Investigate Reform UK Donations

The Metropolitan Police have launched a criminal investigation into donations received by the UK political party Reform UK. The investigation follows claims made after an undercover sting operation. Specific details regarding the nature of the donations or the exact allegations have not been fully disclosed in the coverage.
